fail.description: Handler-level refusal: {status: 'fail', message}. Measured for 401 on a bearer token that cannot be decoded (2026-10-12, both modes); the spec declares the same shape for 400 and 404. The body is built by string concatenation in the service, and no key names the offending field.

problem.description: Framework-level refusal (connexion), as RFC 7807 problem details: a missing token or a non-Bearer Authorization header (401, detail 'No authorization token provided') and an unknown path (404). Measured 2026-10-12, both modes. The spec declares no such body (contract notes VN-03, VN-04).

server-error.description: Unhandled exception, answered with the Werkzeug interactive debugger page (HTML with the stack trace and the failing SQL). Measured 2026-10-12 for every database read on a fresh container, before GET /createdb (contract notes VN-01, VN-02).
